name: Funding-flip basis convergence
hypothesis: Pair short rich perpetual and long spot after a verified funding flip and shrinking premium confirm convergence.
spec: Setup: A change in funding direction may unwind a crowded premium. Entry: Pair short rich perpetual and long spot after a verified funding flip and shrinking premium confirm convergence. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on basis target, widening stop, or funding reversal. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
